title: Chick holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF7A8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F5C518'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='90' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  <rect x='35' y='84' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  <rect x='59' y='84' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FF8C1A'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='24' ry='22' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- wing left (holds heart side) -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='64' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#F5C518' transform='rotate(-20 30 64)'/>
  <!-- wing right -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='66' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#E8B60F' transform='rotate(20 70 66)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='20' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- eye highlight -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='36' r='4' fill='#3A2A00'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='36' r='4' fill='#3A2A00'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='35' r='1.6' fill='#FFFDE0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='35' r='1.6' fill='#FFFDE0'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 46 L54 46 L50 52 Z' fill='#FF7A00'/>
  <!-- tuft -->
  <path d='M48 20 Q50 12 53 20 Q51 18 50 22 Z' fill='#F5C518'/>
  <!-- heart in left wing -->
  <path d='M24 50 C24 44 31 42 33 47 C35 42 42 44 42 50 C42 57 33 63 33 63 C33 63 24 57 24 50 Z' fill='#FF3B6B'/>
  <path d='M28 49 C28 46 31 45 32 47' stroke='#FF8FAE' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
